text:
Eve: Quick Q for leadership — during the all-hands there were a bunch of security/compliance items. Can we do a short run-through: SOC2/ISO timeline, VPC/private availability, audit log retention/export, and KMS/HSM options?

Samira: Great questions. Short answers first:
- SOC 2 Type II: targeting end of Q2 for final report.
- ISO 27001: on roadmap for H2, depending on audit vendor slotting.
- VPC/private: Private preview is live; GA in May for the private control plane.
- Audit logs: default retention 1 year; configurable for Dedicated/Private customers.
- KMS/HSM: BYOK (AWS/GCP KMS) planned this quarter; HSM-backed keys later. :lock:

Miguel: Infra details — private control plane GA scheduled 2024-05-15. On‑prem package is still early access; expecting two pilot customers in June. Networking supports VPC peering + PrivateLink for hosted customers with strict isolation needs.

Tara: Product note — console improvements: org-level audit search and per-token cost/latency traces will ship with the next release; will include filters for time range, model, and route.

Jen: Legal/compliance angle — once SOC 2 Type II is complete customers can request the report via our security portal. Contract language already includes encryption-in-transit and at-rest. For customers needing extra attestations (e.g., healthcare/finance) we have an escalation path.

Ari: Quick operational question — are audit logs immutable? Can auditors get an append-only export?

Samira: Yes. Logs are stored write-once in our audit store. We can produce an append-only, integrity-checked export for audits; delivered encrypted. For Dedicated/Private customers retention and export policies are configurable in the SLA.

Eve: KMS follow-up — will we support automatic rotation and customer-managed rotation?

Samira: Plan: BYOK 1.0 will include rotation hooks + console-triggered manual rotation. We'll surface an API so automation is possible. If customers bring their own HSM, rotation policies are managed by the customer HSM but we will support rotation events and key versioning in our platform.

Ari: For BYOK, which providers first?

Samira: AWS KMS and Google Cloud KMS first. Azure Key Vault is next in priority. HSM-backed keys (FIPS/HSM attestation) require additional compliance work — that's the HSM roadmap item.

Miguel: Networking detail — for Private and Dedicated we route control+data plane traffic over customer VPCs by default. Hosted customers with strict networking can request peering or PrivateLink; those configs are now supported in preview.

Tara: Any pricing impact? Short answer: no immediate change. Dedicated remains contract-based. If we provision managed HSM on a customer's behalf there may be an add-on to cover HSM provider charges; we'll disclose that in the customer quote.

infra-bot: Deploy queued: private-control-plane-vpc-ga -> expected 2024-05-15 :rocket:

Samira: Action items from this thread:
1) Publish SOC 2 Type II roadmap doc by next Wednesday.
2) KMS BYOK spec + console UX doc to docs repo by end of quarter.
3) Audit export playbook (how to request, formats, retention options) by EoM.

Eve: Thanks everyone — helpful. If there are follow-ups, drop them here or DM Samira.

Tara: I'll coordinate on the console UX item and ping infra for the VPC edge cases.

Ari: I'll add a short runbook to the SRE handbook about requesting append-only exports and retention changes.

Jen: I'll prep contract language templates for customers who require HSM attestation.

Samira: Will post a short FAQ in #security once the roadmap doc is live.

Eve: Awesome. :thumbsup:
